rows.question: What is the COP of the LW 9 at A7/W35?
rows.answer: The COP of the LW 9 at A7/W35 is 4.9 [1].

rows.question: How loud is the LW 12 at night at a distance of 3 metres?
rows.answer: The LW 12 produces a sound pressure level of **34 dB(A)** at a distance of 3 m in night mode[1][2].

rows.question: Which refrigerant does the LW series use, and how much is in the LW 6?
rows.answer:
The LW series uses the natural refrigerant R290 (propane)[2].
The LW 6 model contains a refrigerant charge of 0.9 kg[1].

rows.question: Which circuit breaker is recommended for the compressor of the LW 9?
rows.answer: The recommended circuit breaker for the compressor of the LW 9 is **C20 A**[1].

rows.question: How long is the compressor warranty and what do I have to do to get it?
rows.answer:
The extended compressor warranty lasts **10 years** [2]. To obtain it you must:

- Register the unit in the Hollvik partner portal (or at www.hollvik.example/register) within **60 days of commissioning** [1][4].
- Have the heat pump serviced **once a year** by Hollvik service or a certified Hollvik partner, and record each service in the portal (a gap of up to 15 months is accepted) [1][5].

rows.question: Who pays the labour for a warranty repair in the third year?
rows.answer: From the third year the warranty covers only parts; labour (and travel) is charged according to the current service price list, so the customer pays the labour costs [1].

rows.question: Does the warranty apply to a heat pump installed in Switzerland?
rows.answer: No. The warranty is limited to units installed in Germany, Austria and Luxembourg, and does not cover installations in Switzerland[1].

rows.question: How much is the annual maintenance of an LW 12 including VAT?
rows.answer: The annual maintenance for an LW 12 including VAT is €260,61 (gross price)[1].

rows.question: What does error code E03 mean, and may I reset it myself?
rows.answer: Error code E03 indicates a too low water flow (Durchfluss zu gering), usually caused by a clogged filter, closed valves or a blocked pump[3]. The code may be reset by the owner/operator once; if it recurs within 24 hours the installer or Hollvik service must be contacted[1].

rows.question: How far from the wall must the back of the outdoor unit be?
rows.answer: The back of the outdoor unit must be at least 0.3 m from the wall[1].

rows.question: Can the LW 6 cool my house in summer?
rows.answer: No. The LW 6 cannot cool your house in summer; only the LW 9 and LW 12 have cooling capability, and the LW 6’s cooling capacity is listed as “not available”[1][2]

rows.question: Can I connect the control unit to my 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
rows.answer: No. The HC‑2 control unit only works with Wi‑Fi in the 2.4 GHz band; 5 GHz networks are not supported, so you must use a separate 2.4 GHz network for setup. [1][2]

rows.question: What is the minimum system water volume for the LW 12?
rows.answer: The minimum system water volume for the LW 12 is **60 l**[1][2]

rows.question: What happens to the warranty when I sell my house?
rows.answer: The warranty remains attached to the heat‑pump when the house is sold. The new owner must update the registration within 30 days of the ownership change. If the registration is not updated, the standard 5‑year warranty continues, but the extended compressor warranty ends[1].

rows.question: What is included in the Hollvik Plus maintenance contract?
rows.answer:
- Annual maintenance for all models
- Travel service in Zone 1 and Zone 2 for all visits
- 15 % discount on spare parts
- In case of heating failure during the heating season, a technician on‑site within 12 hours
- Documentation of the maintenance in the portal to retain the extended compressor warranty

All these items are part of the Hollvik Plus maintenance contract[1].

rows.question: Wie hoch ist die Anfahrtspauschale für Zone 2?
rows.answer: Die Anfahrtspauschale für Zone 2 (25 bis 50 km) beträgt 55,00 € netto bzw. 65,45 € brutto[1].

rows.question: Welcher Mindestabstand gilt an der Vorderseite des Außengeräts?
rows.answer: Der Mindestabstand an der Vorderseite (Luftaustritt) beträgt 1,5 m [1].

rows.question: Wie viel Kondensat fällt beim Abtauen an?
rows.answer: Beim Abtauen können bis zu 5 Liter Kondensat pro Stunde anfallen. [1]

rows.question: Was bedeutet der Störungscode E12?
rows.answer: Der Störungscode **E12** bedeutet „Übertemperatur“. Ursache kann eine zu hohe Vorlauftemperatur oder ein Kältemittelmangel sein. Der Code kann nicht vom Betreiber zurückgesetzt werden; ein Fachbetrieb muss gerufen werden[1].

rows.question: Bis zu welcher Außentemperatur heizt die Wärmepumpe?
rows.answer: Die Wärmepumpe kann im Heizbetrieb bei Außentemperaturen von ‑25 °C bis +35 °C arbeiten[2]. Außerdem wird ausdrücklich angegeben, dass alle LW‑Modelle bis zu einer Außentemperatur von ‑25 °C heizen[1].

rows.question: Wie schnell muss ein Techniker bei einem kompletten Heizungsausfall im Januar vor Ort sein?
rows.answer: Ein Techniker muss bei einem kompletten Heizungsausfall in der Heizperiode (z. B. im Januar) innerhalb von 24 Stunden vor Ort sein[1].

rows.question: Bis zu welchem Betrag darf ein Techniker ohne Rücksprache Kulanz gewähren?
rows.answer: Bis zu 150 Euro netto darf ein Techniker vor Ort Kulanz gewähren, ohne Rücksprache.[1]

rows.question: Welcher Zuschlag gilt für einen Notdiensteinsatz am Sonntag?
rows.answer: Der Zuschlag für einen Notdiensteinsatz an Sonntagen beträgt 60 % auf Arbeitszeit und Anfahrt [1].

rows.question: Auf welchen Anlagendruck wird die Anlage bei der Inbetriebnahme eingestellt?
rows.answer: Der Anlagendruck wird im kalten Zustand auf **1,5 bar** eingestellt (maximal 2,5 bar im Betrieb)[1].

rows.question: Welche Wasserqualität muss das Heizungswasser haben?
rows.answer: Das Heizungswasser muss einen pH‑Wert von 8,2 bis 10 haben und die Gesamthärte darf maximal 11,2 °dH (2,0 mmol/l) betragen. [1]

rows.question: LW 9'un yıllık bakımı ne kadar tutuyor?
rows.answer: LW 9’un yıllık bakımı net 189,00 (brüt 224,91) tutmaktadır[1].

rows.question: Kompresör garantisi kaç yıl?
rows.answer: Kompresör için standart garanti 5 yıldır; koşulları sağlandığında uzatılmış kompresör garantisi 10 yıldır [1].

rows.question: LW 6 gece modunda 3 metreden ne kadar ses çıkarıyor?
rows.answer: LW 6, gece modunda 3 m mesafeden yaklaşık **30 dB(A)** ses çıkarır[1][2]

rows.question: Elektrik kesilirse ısı pompası ne yapar?
rows.answer: Elektrik kesildiğinde ısı pompası, güç geri geldiğinde otomatik olarak yeniden başlar ve tüm ayarları korunur. Ancak, eğer kurulumda don koruma vanaları veya antifriz takılmadıysa, kışın uzun süren bir kesinti dış ünitenin zarar görmesine yol açabilir; bu konuda kurulumcunuzla görüşmeniz önerilir. [1]

rows.question: Evinde bebek olan bir müşterinin ısıtması tamamen arızalanırsa servis talebi hangi önceliğe girer?
rows.answer: Tam ısıtma arızası yaşayan ve bebek bulunan bir hane, her zaman P1 önceliğine sınıflandırılır[1].
